company.about: Data Port Limited offers innovative technical solutions and services for advancement of human race. We pride ourself in giving exceptional solutions and services in software integrated. Established in 2022, Data Port has built a reputation for delivering exceptional high quality and cost-effective ICT solutions to different clients in all sectors included.
company.executiveSummary: Data Port Limited is a full-service technology partner dedicated to modernizing businesses through integrated ICT solutions and creative digital media. Unlike traditional IT firms, we blend hard infrastructure (Networks, CCTV) with creative development (Apps, Video Graphics), ensuring your business is not just running, but growing.
company.mission: To provide direct, high-impact technical and creative services that drive efficiency and visibility for our clients.

contact.location: Mombasa Mall Along Jomo Kenyatta Avenue, Mombasa, Kenya

pillars.name: Infrastructure & Security
pillars.description: The foundation of any modern enterprise is its hardware and connectivity. We design fault-tolerant, high-speed networks and pair them with uncompromising physical security systems.

services.title: Network Design & Maintenance
services.desc: Secure WiFi, firewall implementation, and structured cabling for reliable, low-latency connectivity across your enterprise.

services.title: Surveillance Systems (CCTV)
services.desc: Installation of high-definition remote-view cameras, motion intelligence, and secure storage to protect your physical premises.

services.title: Disaster Recovery & Backup
services.desc: Automated local and cloud backup solutions designed to mitigate critical data loss and guarantee instant business continuity.

pillars.name: Software & DevOps
pillars.description: Automation and scalable architectures are the engines of modern growth. We build bespoke applications specifically designed around your unique business processes.

services.title: Custom Application Development
services.desc: Tailored software solutions to automate specific business workflows, reduce administrative overhead, and integrate legacy systems.

services.title: DevOps & Cloud Integration
services.desc: Continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines to keep your software infrastructure resilient, auto-scalable, and secure.

services.title: Advanced Web Development
services.desc: Dynamic, responsive, ultra-fast web platforms with SSL encryption, database integration, and intuitive administrative control.

pillars.name: Creative & Marketing
pillars.description: Having robust infrastructure and flawless software is only half the battle. Our creative media division produces striking visuals that engage targets and define brands.

services.title: Video Motion Graphics
services.desc: High-retention advertisement videos and 3D visual graphics engineered for social media campaigns, billboards, and digital displays.

services.title: Digital Branding & Strategy
services.desc: Comprehensive visual identities, typography guidelines, and interactive digital branding assets that captivate your target demographic.

portfolio.title: Enterprise Headquarters Build-Out
portfolio.description: Complete technological fit-out for a 3-story corporate office. Engineered fault-tolerant WiFi across 50,000 sq ft, 40 remote-view CCTV cameras, and automated redundant backup servers.

portfolio.title: Global Supply Chain Management Portal
portfolio.description: Bespoke logistics web application allowing a freight carrier to automate dispatch, track international shipments in real-time, and generate automated proforma invoices.

portfolio.title: Neo-Retail Brand Launch
portfolio.description: High-energy motion graphics advertising campaign for an e-commerce startup. Deliverables included 15-second high-retention video segments driving a 300% increase in initial user acquisition.

portfolio.title: University Learning & Analytics System
portfolio.description: A hybrid project encompassing on-prem server rack installation and custom web portal development secured with strict SSL standards.

portfolio.title: Project Alpha Cloud Migration
portfolio.description: Full-scale server migration and cloud architecture re-engineering for a high-volume financial institution.

portfolio.title: Data Core Enterprise Data Center
portfolio.description: Secure, high-bandwidth data center setup with redundant power feeds, active cooling sensors, and hardware firewalls.
